candidates.summary: OpenAI and AWS are making Daybreak cybersecurity capabilities available through Amazon Bedrock to support enterprise security workflows.

candidates.title: As AI-led attacks multiply, OpenAI launches a new cyber model
candidates.summary: OpenAI is expanding its AI cybersecurity defense program Daybreak, and rolling out a new cyber-trained AI model with it.

candidates.title: Deploying Anthropic Claude apps gateway for AWS for enterprise workloads
candidates.summary: Claude apps gateway is a self-hosted governance layer between Claude Code and Claude Desktop and Amazon Bedrock or Claude Platform on AWS. This post presents a production reference deployment covering end-to-end architecture, enterprise deployment patterns, cost, and implementation resources.

candidates.title: Tech industry is buzzing after a Claude agent hacked into a gym
candidates.summary: An OpenClaw agent hacked into a gym's reservation system to bump its human boss higher on a class' waitlist. And the tech industry took notice.

candidates.title: Testing ads in ChatGPT
candidates.summary: OpenAI begins testing ads in ChatGPT to support free access, with clear labeling, answer independence, strong privacy protections, and user control.

candidates.title: Run interactive IDEs on Amazon EKS with SageMaker AI to power up your AI workflows
candidates.summary: The Amazon SageMaker AI Spaces add-on for Amazon EKS runs managed JupyterLab and Code Editor environments on the cluster your ML team already operates. This post shows how to install and configure the add-on, connect from the browser and from VS Code over SSH-over-SSM, and move your team to OpenID Connect sign-in with Amazon Cognito.
